description:
Full size bike can be split apart to fit into travel case

Patented locking compression system adds only 100 grams

Extra lightweight custom drawn and mitered 3/2.5 Ti tubing

Bead blasted graphics

Bridgeless chainstays for increased tire clearance

Rack eyelets

WCS carbon cross fork and WCS drop-in headset included

Case, padding, cable disconnects and couplers also included in frame kit
